source_policy: Derived corpus statistics only; original Softimage assets are not committed.
priority: Asset reconstruction fidelity: geometry, hierarchy, transforms, UVs, texture placement and tiling. Historical floor/render lighting matching is not a gate for this stage.

model_local_code400.implementation_consequence: This subset can use the working 1..5 fitted-support UV generator without first solving nonidentity +90. Repeats are applied before +6 scale/offset and crop.

model_local_code400.important: Full-archive code 400 is not limited to codes 1..5 and is not universally identity-matrix.

material_level_code401.important: The full source archive has a much larger matrix frontier than the nested showcase subset.

projection_generator_policy.scope: practical mapping validated primarily against the nested high-resolution asset family
projection_generator_policy.nonidentity_policy: defer meaningful +90 transforms until UVW application/direction is recovered
projection_generator_policy.source_uv_policy: never overwrite imported HRC UV maps

texture_placement.repeat: Recovered SI_Texture2D URepeat/VRepeat at +2/+4 is applied before +6 placement.
texture_placement.portable_gltf: Repeat, scale/offset and crop are composed into KHR_texture_transform for bound portable base textures when nonidentity.

7.working_status: strong reflection/environment-associated special material mode; not forced through ordinary geometric UV projection

8.working_status: broader environment/specular-associated state; nested cavern/glass usage is subset-specific

retracted_inference.plus78_code5_exclusivity: Does not hold in the full outer archive; +78=1 occurs with multiple +24 codes and relation scopes.
retracted_inference.global_code5_cylindrical_from_plus78: Retracted. Code 5 may remain a practical nested-subset working mapping, but +78 is not supporting evidence globally.

model_material_composition.nested_high_resolution_observation: 266 code-400 models also have code-401 material textures, but the target texture objects do not overlap. Common combinations include rusty model-local state plus stripes/blueglow material layers.
model_material_composition.current_policy: Preserve both scopes; do not invent a final cross-scope blend order until composition is better established.

remaining_asset_fidelity_frontier: source-generation-aware interpretation/handling for +24 codes 6 and 8 and other full-archive model-local states
exact +90 UVW rotation application for meaningful nonidentity code-400/code-401 records
model-local code-400 plus ordered material code-401 composition, including alpha overlays and bump routing
authoritative UAlternate/VAlternate/UVSwap behavior when non-default source anchors are recovered
